name: formula-preserving-workbook-engineering
intent: Modify spreadsheet packages while preserving computational lineage and verifying formulas, caches, references, and rendered output.
successCondition: Stop after formula identity, recalculation deltas, package integrity, and rendered sheets are verified against the requested change.
operations: inventory formulas names links and calculation settings
recalculate through a compatible engine when available
compare formulas values references and rendered sheets
positiveTriggers: Change an authorized workbook while preserving formulas and references.
Repair spreadsheet structure and verify recalculation and rendering.
negativeTriggers: Trust a library round trip without package and visual verification.
failureModes: stop when formula lineage or external links cannot be reconciled
retain the original when recalculation changes unexplained cells
exclusions: does not silently sever external references
does not treat cached display values as formulas
terminationConditions: Stop after formula identity, recalculation deltas, package integrity, and rendered sheets are verified against the requested change.

measurableImprovement.baseline: the current eternities-daedalus route without this exact operational mechanism
measurableImprovement.threshold: all critical cases pass with exact evidence and no authority or effect regression
